title: Cream-Filled Choux Pastry Bites
description: A Chinese-inspired dessert, these cream-filled choux pastry bites are a perfect fusion of French and Asian flavors.
instructions: Line a baking sheet with parchment paper.
In a medium saucepan, combine the warm water, sugar, and melted butter.
Bring to a boil, then reduce the heat to medium-low and simmer for 5 minutes.
Add the flour and cook, stirring constantly, for 2-3 minutes.
Remove from heat and let cool slightly.
Add the eggs one at a time, stirring well after each addition.
Pipe the dough into small balls and bake for 15-20 minutes, or until golden brown.
Allow the pastry balls to cool completely.
Split each pastry ball in half horizontally using a serrated knife.
Fill the pastry shells with whipped cream and a sprinkle of matcha powder.
